_what: The creative system as one standard: the loop from research to iteration, the ladder from avatar to opening swaps, the parts of one ad, one meaning per word, the brief's fields, and where the video chain does or does not carry each step. Built from the owner's written procedures and recorded walkthroughs (read 2026-11-17) reconciled with the chain as it runs. A PROPOSAL: status draft until the owner rules each call. Brand-agnostic; the source texts stay in the owner's own knowledge store.
sources: 75 pages and 30 recorded walkthroughs: the creative process hub and its parent, the procedures on research, thinking, architecture, approval, prioritization, iteration and compounding, the four brief prompts, the glossary, the creation, editing and remix procedures, the strategist and creator training, three brief queues, the feedback record, the research index, the static analysis, hand-off, daily check-in and media buying procedures, and the creator and agency briefs. One page (the AI video analysis) could not be opened; older archived briefs were listed, not read.

calls.q: A brief has three ways in: from a viral post (inspiration), from customer insight (research), from a winner (iteration).
calls.yes: All three become front doors of the chain. Today only the first runs end to end.

calls.q: The ladder is avatar, angle, concept, script, variations, opening swaps.
calls.yes: The chain gains a concept step; today it goes from angle straight to a script.

calls.q: Two names for the body's two choices: framework (the shape of the argument) and format (how it is presented and made). The training already files briefs this way.
calls.yes: These replace script format and production format. Demonstration and testimonial move to formats, where the training has them.

calls.q: The opening is three parts: scroll stopper (seen), headline (read), hook (heard). The glossary uses hook for all three; the procedures use it for the spoken line.
calls.yes: Hook means the first spoken line everywhere; the three together are the opening.

calls.q: Every ad carries five things: the problem, why it matters, the mechanism, the transformation, the ask.
calls.yes: The older line about asking for nothing is retired.

calls.q: Working means spend: a winner takes at least half of its test's budget within 14 days, at or under the cost per customer the campaign is running at.
calls.yes: One test, one grade scale, and one cost target per brand instead of the four different numbers on file.

calls.q: The weekly mix: five new concepts, three built on winners, one from research, one from a viral post. Sources: mostly what the avatar already watches, the rest adjacent markets.
calls.yes: The queue and the swipe picks are planned to that mix.

calls.q: Per brief: four variations. Per variation: the same body under three hooks and three scroll stoppers.
calls.yes: Production and the edit count to these numbers.

calls.q: People step in at three points only: choosing the angle and concept, reading the script aloud, approving the finished ad.
calls.yes: Everything else runs on its own.

calls.q: One format list and one framework list, merged from the training and the bank, as in the table below.
calls.yes: Every list in the chain reads from them, and the Format Map is re-sorted to match.

loop.name: 1 Research
loop.sop: Customer words first: surveys, lost checkouts, ad comments, reviews. Then the wider market, then deeper: stories, science, root cause, a day in their life.
loop.now: Research and language tools exist and feed writing.
loop.gap: Runs when asked, not on a weekly and monthly rhythm.

loop.name: 2 Creative research
loop.sop: Find what the avatar already watches: a fresh feed trained as them. Save the formats and how they talk.
loop.now: The organic feed board and 52 saved structures.
loop.gap: 50 of 52 structures were never reviewed; formats and structures are filed apart.

loop.name: 3 Angle and concept
loop.sop: Find the belief, find the gap in it: that is the angle. Then the concept. Then the elements for that angle: avatar snapshot, hooks, scroll stoppers, mechanism, tone, objections, numbers. Check it twice.
loop.now: Angles sit in each brand's list; the strategist's ask names one.
loop.gap: No concept step. The elements are spread across several writing stages, never held as one checked set per angle.

loop.name: 4 Brief
loop.sop: Three ways in: inspiration, research, iteration. Three shapes out, by who makes it: an angle brief for an agency, a format brief for an in-house shoot, a creator brief.
loop.now: Inspiration runs: swipe, teardown, writing. Briefs for the AI line and for creators both exist.
loop.gap: The research door stops at the first writing step. The iteration door has a planner nothing reads.

loop.name: 5 Approve the structure
loop.sop: A gate before anything is made: the five things every ad carries, the right words, still feels native.
loop.now: Writing has an audit and checks.
loop.gap: The checks are not these five; some are run twice, some are notes only.

loop.name: 6 Produce
loop.sop: Check what footage exists. Make what is missing: voice, B-roll, pictures. Statics from the same script.
loop.now: Voice, pictures and clips are made; footage is searched.
loop.gap: Two production lines; owned footage that is picked never reaches the edit.

loop.name: 7 Edit and remix
loop.sop: Tight opening, natural captions, cut to the beat. Then remix: new openings on a body that works.
loop.now: The edit makes one version per hook on the same body.
loop.gap: No scroll stopper or headline swaps as such; no search for hooks hiding inside the body.

loop.name: 8 Launch
loop.sop: Name it angle, concept, actor so results join back. Hand over the video, three texts, three headlines, two descriptions and the checked link. Approve.
loop.now: Naming, ad words from a live card, the approval card, the click to go live.
loop.gap: Names carry no concept today. Sits outside the four mapped components.

loop.name: 9 Analyze and grade
loop.sop: Every two weeks: top ads by spend. Break each down part by part, video and static. File what was learned. Grade it.
loop.now: The winners tool ranks by spend and banks the top ads.
loop.gap: No part-by-part breakdown of our own winners; no grade on the brief.

loop.name: 10 Iterate
loop.sop: Keep what works, change one layer: the opening, the concept, the format, or the awareness level it enters at. Then hand the proven brief to creators.
loop.now: A variation planner writes a plan.
loop.gap: Nothing reads the plan, so a winner never becomes the next brief by itself.

ladder.name: Avatar
ladder.gives: The angle, the language and the tone come from them.
ladder.eg: a young man, bumps after shaving

ladder.name: Angle
ladder.is: How we open the conversation. The door.
ladder.gives: Found in the gap in something they already believe.

ladder.name: Concept
ladder.is: The voice and situation that carries the angle.

ladder.name: Framework and format
ladder.is: Framework: the shape of the argument. Format: how it is presented and made.
ladder.gives: The format gives the hook, the scroll stopper and the lead.
ladder.eg: before and after, as a reaction video

ladder.name: Variations
ladder.eg: a different person, room or proof

ladder.name: Opening swaps
ladder.is: The same body under a new scroll stopper, headline or hook.

ladder_rule: When an ad fails, check the script first, then the concept, then the angle. When one wins, write more scripts under the same concept, then new concepts under the same angle.
